title: How many hours can students work abroad?
caption: Can you work while studying abroad? Usually yes, but there are limits ⏰ UK ~20 hrs/week in term, Canada 24 hrs/week off-campus, Australia 48 hrs per fortnight, Germany 140 full or 280 half days a year. Rules change: always check the official site! #studyabroad #studentvisa #parttimejob

scenes.backdrop: lively city center at night with shops, cafés and lights

beats.text: Quddus! When I get my visa, I'll work full time and study part time. Money, money, money!
beats.say: Kuddus! When I get my visa, I'll work full time and study part time. Money, money, money!
Zara, no! Student visas usually limit how many hours you can work during term.
It depends on the country. Here are the common rules right now. But always check the official website, because rules change.

scenes.backdrop: cozy shared student apartment living room with a sofa and city view

beats.say: Many countries allow more hours or full time during official breaks. Again, check the exact rule for your visa.
What if I work a bit more than allowed? Nobody will know.
They can find out through taxes and payroll. Breaking the rules can cost you your visa. It's not worth it.
Study first, work smart, and stay legal. Got it!
